visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short dark hair, wearing a black and white striped long-sleeved shirt, stands in a modern kitchen. She holds a large stainless steel mixing bowl containing a smooth mass of pale dough. She tilts the bowl to pour the dough onto a white marble surface, then places the bowl onto a white digital kitchen scale. (2) Close-up shot focusing on the woman's hands as she uses a white plastic dough scraper to cut the dough into several smaller, equal-sized portions on the marble countertop. She then uses her palms to roll each portion into a neat ball shape. (3) The camera focuses on specific ingredients: a bag of PowerRed Mozzarella/Cheddar shredded cheese being poured into a black bowl, a yellow container of Kraft Parmesan Cheese being shaken onto a white plate, and a bottle of Beerenberg Australian Tomato Sauce being poured into a small white dish. (4) The woman uses a white rolling pin to flatten a ball of dough into an oblong shape. She spreads a layer of red tomato sauce in the center, adds a handful of shredded cheese, and rolls the dough into a cylindrical log, sealing the edges with her fingers. (5) Each dough log is dipped into the parmesan cheese powder on the white plate until coated, then placed onto a black baking sheet lined with parchment paper. (6) The woman opens a white Sharp Healsio steam oven and slides a tray of prepared rolls into the middle rack. She looks at the camera with a friendly smile. (7) Using a sharp blade, the woman carefully makes two parallel diagonal slashes on the top of each unbaked dough roll to score it, revealing the cheese filling inside. (8) Two separate trays of rolls are shown being placed into two different white Sharp Healsio ovens stacked vertically. The oven displays show digital timers and temperature settings. (9) The woman, now wearing grey oven mitts, carefully removes a tray of golden-brown, freshly baked bread rolls from the oven. Steam is visible. She holds the tray towards the camera, looking proud. (10) Close-up shots of the finished bread on a cooling rack, showing a crispy, cheese-dusted exterior. Finally, two hands pull one bread roll apart, revealing a stretchy, melted yellow cheese interior as it is torn open.

(3) A muffled percussive sound occurs as the dough is rolled on the surface. The narrator's speech rate is moderate and clear.
